data.title: 2. Bundesliga preview: FC St. Pauli vs. Karlsruher SC | OneFootball
data.content:
St. Pauli won the most recent meeting between the sides in Hamburg, and home advantage could prove important once again. Nevertheless, with both teams struggling for consistency, Sunday’s encounter is unlikely to be straightforward for either side.

### Team news

FC St. Pauli: Tomoya Ando is suspended following his sending-off against Energie Cottbus. Marcus Mathisen remains unavailable as he continues to recover from heel problems and is not expected to return until next week. [...] OneFootball's home page

## 2. Bundesliga preview: FC St. Pauli vs. Karlsruher SC [...] Their most recent league match ended in a 1-0 home defeat to Nürnberg, with Karlsruhe once again struggling to make their attacking possession count. They had previously suffered a 3-0 loss to Energie Cottbus, while a 2-2 draw away to Hannover 96 offered some encouragement after their home defeat to Wolfsburg.
